task.ques: On the Apple website, find out if the Mac Mini can be configured with a GPU larger than 16-core.

claude.final_answer: FINAL: Yes. The Mac mini can be configured with an M5 Pro chip featuring an 18-core CPU and a 20-core GPU, exceeding 16 GPU cores. Apple’s “Configure to Order” section lists this option. Source: https://www.apple.com/mac-mini/specs/ (checked October 27, 2026). Evidence: final.png.
